body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Münster, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Erbdrostenhof, Salzstraße, 38. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio walking tour explores Münster's historic heart, blending Gothic churches, Baroque palaces, and serene lakeside paths. History enthusiasts and first-time visitors find vivid stories of prince-bishops, peace treaties, and resilient merchants that shaped this Westphalian city.[1][5]
>
> The route starts at the elegant Erbdrostenhof on Salzstraße, loops through the Historical City Hall, St. Lambert's Church, Prinzipalmarkt arcades, St.-Paulus-Dom, Kiepenkerl-Denkmal, Liebfrauen-Überwasserkirche, Aasee lake, Schloss Münster, Botanical Garden, and ends near Tuckesburg by the Allwetterzoo, covering the old town's core and green outskirts on flat, mostly cobblestoned paths.[1][7]
>
> Travelers encounter striking sights like iron cages on crooked towers marking Anabaptist rebellions, gabled merchant houses echoing Hanseatic trade, giant pool balls by Aasee, and a fairy-tale villa tied to zoo origins, each revealing layers of medieval drama, war resilience, and innovative rebirth through concrete sensory details.[2][4]
